
'''Yatsurugi Shrines''' (八剣神社, also written as 剣神社, 剔神社, or 剣神社) also read as Yatsurugi Shrines refer to Shinto shrines. These shrines often enshrine eight swords as sacred objects or deities, including Susanoo-no-Mikoto, Ōkuninushi, and Prince Yamato Takeru.

== Kantō Region ==
* Yatsurugi Hachiman Shrine - Located in Fujimi, Kisarazu, Chiba Prefecture.
* Yatsurugi Shrine (Narashino) - Located in Saginuma, Narashino, Chiba Prefecture.
* Yatsurugi Shrine - Located in Okudo, Katsushika, Tokyo.
* Yatsurugi Shrine (Chōfu) - Located in Kikunodai, Chōfu, Tokyo.
